zh: 显示 AI 剩余额度
支持 PNG、JPG、WebP 与 HEIC，替换后首页立即同步。
en: Supports PNG, JPG, WebP and HEIC. Changes appear on Home immediately.

zh: 在飞牛网页生成 6 位配对码后绑定。
en: Generate a 6-digit pairing code on the NAS web page, then pair here.

zh: 统一网关 Bearer 不可用时，可添加「设备同步端口」endpoint（与网关可并存）。端口不写死，请填写 FPK 展示的完整 URL。
en: If gateway Bearer access is unavailable, add a device sync port endpoint alongside the gateway. Use the full URL shown by the FPK; the port is not fixed.

zh: 不安全连接：已启用明文 HTTP endpoint，设备令牌与待办可能被窃听或篡改
en: Insecure connection: HTTP endpoint enabled. Device tokens and tasks may be intercepted or modified

zh: 同步已暂停 · 预览本机覆盖 NAS
en: Sync paused · Preview replacing NAS data with local data

zh: 回退最近 NAS 快照
收起时可拖动；点一下展开
en: Drag while collapsed; click to expand

zh: 登录后自动运行 Pome Panel
Windows 原生能力 · 实验功能
开启后首页显示「当前窗口」，剪贴板可自动粘贴
en: Enables Current windows on Home and automatic clipboard paste

zh: 实时转写与智能命名 · 密钥仅加密保存在本机
en: Live transcription & smart naming · Keys are stored encrypted locally

zh: 通义百炼实时转写 API Key
en: Model Studio live transcription API key
sk-… (leave blank to keep the saved key)

zh: 前往阿里云百炼创建或管理 API Key
en: Create or manage an API key in Alibaba Cloud Model Studio
Leave blank to keep the saved key

zh: 前往 DeepSeek 创建或管理 API Key
en: Create or manage a DeepSeek API key

zh: API Key 会由系统安全存储加密，渲染页面无法读取。
en: API keys are encrypted using system secure storage and cannot be read by the renderer.

zh: 这是安装时填写的固定端口。默认仅本机；开启「局域网」后可用 http://NAS内网IP:端口。外网访问时，使用你映射后的外网地址（公网 IP 或域名 + 端口）。不要填成 NAS:34931，除非安装时填的就是 34931。同步端口默认是明文 HTTP，直接暴露到公网有被扫描和访问的风险。
en: This is the fixed port configured during installation. It listens on localhost by default; enable LAN to use http://NAS-LAN-IP:PORT. For remote access use your mapped public IP or domain and port. Do not use NAS:34931 unless you configured 34931. HTTP is unencrypted by default; public exposure risks scanning and unauthorized access.

zh: 在已登录的飞牛会话下生成配对码，于桌面「设置 → NAS 同步」完成绑定。配对码只显示一次。
en: Generate a code while signed in to the NAS, then pair in desktop Settings → NAS sync. The code is shown only once.

zh: 剪贴板随桌面同步，这里不能清空
en: Clipboard syncs from desktop and cannot be cleared here

zh: 请填写本机设备同步端口（1 到 65535）并选择监听范围。内网 IP 同步：选「局域网」，在同一局域网内用 http://NAS内网IP:端口 同步。外网 IP 同步：选「局域网」，并通过路由器端口转发、DDNS 域名等方式，把外网 IP 的端口转到 NAS 的该端口；也可以选「仅本机」，改用 FRP、反向代理、VPN 等方式转发到 127.0.0.1:端口。安全提示：同步端口默认是明文 HTTP，直接暴露到公网有被扫描和访问的风险。外网使用建议加 HTTPS、走 VPN，或用反向代理限制来源，并妥善保管配对码。不要对公网开放不必要的端口。保存后到应用中心重启本应用。安装完成后从飞牛应用中心打开；配对码在「设备」里生成。登录沿用飞牛当前账号，不需要再注册。
en: Enter a device sync port (1–65535) and choose a listening scope. For LAN access, choose LAN and use http://NAS-LAN-IP:PORT. For remote access, forward a public IP/domain port to this NAS port, or choose localhost and use FRP, a reverse proxy or VPN to forward to 127.0.0.1:PORT. The sync port uses unencrypted HTTP by default; exposing it publicly risks scanning and unauthorized access. Use HTTPS, a VPN or a source-restricted reverse proxy, and protect pairing codes. Do not expose unnecessary ports. Restart this app from App Center after saving. Open the app from App Center; generate codes in Devices. Your current NAS account is used, with no separate registration.

zh: 请填写本机设备同步端口（1 到 65535）并选择监听范围。就算这次没保存成功，应用也会先启用，之后可以在「应用设置」补上端口并重启。内网 IP 同步：选「局域网」，在同一局域网内用 http://NAS内网IP:端口 同步。外网 IP 同步：选「局域网」，并通过路由器端口转发、DDNS 域名等方式，把外网 IP 的端口转到 NAS 的该端口；也可以选「仅本机」，改用 FRP、反向代理、VPN 等方式转发到 127.0.0.1:端口。安全提示：同步端口默认是明文 HTTP，直接暴露到公网有被扫描和访问的风险。外网使用建议加 HTTPS、走 VPN，或用反向代理限制来源，并妥善保管配对码。不要对公网开放不必要的端口。保存后到应用中心重启本应用。
en: Enter a device sync port (1–65535) and choose a listening scope. The app can start even if this setting is not saved; configure it later in App Settings and restart. Choose LAN for local IP access at http://NAS-LAN-IP:PORT. For remote access, forward a public IP or DDNS port to this NAS port, or use localhost with FRP, a reverse proxy or VPN forwarding to 127.0.0.1:PORT. HTTP is unencrypted by default; public exposure risks scanning and unauthorized access. Use HTTPS, a VPN or source restrictions and protect pairing codes. Restart this app from App Center after saving.

zh: 请输入 1 到 65535 之间的端口
仅本机（127.0.0.1）：只有 NAS 本机能访问，适合搭配反向代理或穿透工具，由它们再转发到本机该端口。
en: Localhost (127.0.0.1): accessible only on the NAS. Use a reverse proxy or tunneling tool to forward to this local port.

zh: 局域网（0.0.0.0）：同一局域网可用内网 IP 同步，也可以配合外网方式使用。
en: LAN (0.0.0.0): use the NAS LAN IP from the same network, or combine with remote access.

zh: 请填写本机设备同步端口（1 到 65535）并选择监听范围。内网 IP 同步：选「局域网」，在同一局域网内用 http://NAS内网IP:端口 同步。外网 IP 同步：选「局域网」，并通过路由器端口转发、DDNS 域名等方式，把外网 IP 的端口转到 NAS 的该端口；也可以选「仅本机」，改用 FRP、反向代理、VPN 等方式转发到 127.0.0.1:端口。安全提示：同步端口默认是明文 HTTP，直接暴露到公网有被扫描和访问的风险。外网使用建议加 HTTPS、走 VPN，或用反向代理限制来源，并妥善保管配对码。不要对公网开放不必要的端口。保存后到应用中心重启本应用。
en: Enter a device sync port (1–65535) and choose a listening scope. Choose LAN to use http://NAS-LAN-IP:PORT locally, with router port forwarding or DDNS for remote access. Alternatively choose localhost and forward to 127.0.0.1:PORT using FRP, a reverse proxy or VPN. HTTP is unencrypted by default; public exposure risks scanning and unauthorized access. Prefer HTTPS, a VPN or source restrictions and protect pairing codes. Do not expose unnecessary ports. Restart this app from App Center after saving.

zh: 没填端口时应用也能启用，只是桌面还不能同步。请填写本机设备同步端口（1 到 65535）并选择监听范围。内网 IP 同步：选「局域网」，在同一局域网内用 http://NAS内网IP:端口 同步。外网 IP 同步：选「局域网」，并通过路由器端口转发、DDNS 域名等方式，把外网 IP 的端口转到 NAS 的该端口；也可以选「仅本机」，改用 FRP、反向代理、VPN 等方式转发到 127.0.0.1:端口。安全提示：同步端口默认是明文 HTTP，直接暴露到公网有被扫描和访问的风险。外网使用建议加 HTTPS、走 VPN，或用反向代理限制来源，并妥善保管配对码。不要对公网开放不必要的端口。保存后到应用中心重启本应用。
en: The app can start without a port, but desktop sync will not work yet. Enter a device sync port (1–65535) and choose a listening scope. Choose LAN to use http://NAS-LAN-IP:PORT locally, with port forwarding or DDNS for remote access. Alternatively choose localhost and forward to 127.0.0.1:PORT using FRP, a reverse proxy or VPN. HTTP is unencrypted by default; public exposure risks scanning and unauthorized access. Prefer HTTPS, a VPN or source restrictions and protect pairing codes. Do not expose unnecessary ports. Restart the app after saving.

zh: 保留或删除应用设置。仅卸载可保留现有文件以便重装。
en: Choose whether to keep app data. Keeping it lets you continue after reinstalling.

zh: 保留现有文件，重新安装后可以继续使用
en: Keep existing files for use after reinstalling

zh: 清除所有应用数据文件（不可恢复）!!!
en: Delete all app data (cannot be undone)

zh: 清除所有应用数据文件，此操作不可恢复
en: All app data files will be permanently deleted. This action cannot be undone

zh: 请选择是否保留应用数据
en: Choose whether to keep app data

zh: 点击「新建」即可开始记录。
日出日落需要知道你在哪座城市
en: Choose a city for sunrise and sunset times
Location is stored on this device only

zh: 粘贴一个网址，Pome Panel 会读取标题并放进合适的分组。
en: Paste a URL. Pome Panel will fetch its title and suggest a group.

zh: 粘贴网址并回车，添加到此分组
en: Paste a URL and press Enter to add it to this group

zh: 可按名称或账号继续检索
账号与密码会加密保存在本机
en: Accounts and passwords are encrypted on this device

zh: Pome Panel 需要访问局域网中的飞牛 NAS 以同步数据。
en: Pome Panel accesses your NAS on the local network to sync your workspace.

zh: 手动 Token 请求失败，已改用本机登录态
en: Manual token request failed · Using local sign-in

zh: 无法读取对端证书，未保存信任
en: Couldn't read the remote certificate. Trust was not saved

zh: Pome Panel 需要使用摄像头来显示「镜子」预览。
en: Pome Panel uses the camera for the Mirror preview when you open it.

zh: Pome Panel 需要控制「系统事件」来枚举并聚焦当前窗口、发送汽水音乐快捷键。
en: Pome Panel uses System Events to list and focus windows and send Soda Music shortcuts.

zh: 手动 Token 已失效，已改用本机登录态
en: Manual token invalid · Using local sign-in

zh: 0.9.14：设备同步端口可选局域网监听（0.0.0.0）。默认仅监听 127.0.0.1（仅本机）。应用设置新增监听范围。启动入口仍是 TRIM_APPDEST/server。同步协议仍在 target/packages/sync-protocol。卸载仍可保留或删除数据。
en: 0.9.14: Device sync supports optional LAN listening (0.0.0.0), with localhost (127.0.0.1) as the default. App Settings adds Listen scope. The startup entry remains TRIM_APPDEST/server and the sync protocol remains in target/packages/sync-protocol. Uninstall can keep or delete app data.

zh: 已写入配置，请退出 Claude Code 并重新启动后生效
en: Configuration saved. Exit Claude Code, then start it again to apply the changes.

zh: 识别语言用于下一次录音，不随界面语言改变。
en: Applies to the next recording. Changing the interface language does not change this setting.

zh: 在飞牛上查看 Pome Panel 工作区，并与桌面配对。界面走统一网关 /app/pome-panel。没配端口时网关仍会启动；配好后默认监听 127.0.0.1，可选局域网 0.0.0.0。
en: View your Pome Panel workspace on the NAS and pair with the desktop app. The interface uses the unified gateway /app/pome-panel. The gateway starts even without a configured port. Device sync defaults to 127.0.0.1, with optional LAN listening on 0.0.0.0.

zh: 请选择 Pome Panel 的安装目录。程序文件保存在此目录，桌面将创建启动快捷方式。
en: Choose where to install Pome Panel. Program files will be stored there; a shortcut will be created on your desktop.

zh:
此向导将安装 Pome Panel。

下一步可以选择程序的安装目录。安装完成后，将在桌面和开始菜单创建启动快捷方式。
en:
This wizard will install Pome Panel.

Choose an installation folder on the next page. Shortcuts will be created on the desktop and in the Start menu.

zh: Pome Panel 需要使用麦克风来录音并生成转写文本。
en: Pome Panel uses the microphone to record audio when you start recording. Transcription is optional.
